title: Talk with Maria about family

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: Hi.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hi.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: Yes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: What about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about it?

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: I come from an illustrious family, dating back from before the bunker wars.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I come from an illustrious family, dating back from before the bunker wars.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: My ancestors lineages mixed with the Carovago family.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My ancestors lineages mixed with the Carovago family.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: Doesn't matter anymore. You can look them up on the Nets. Shouldn't be classified.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doesn't matter anymore. You can look them up on the Nets. Shouldn't be classified.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: Everyone's family tree is old. But mine is distinguished.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Everyone's family tree is old. But mine is distinguished.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: The difference is I know exactly where my genes come from, and they come from people of import. My family is prestigious. My name stands eternal, like a sacred temple.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The difference is I know exactly where my genes come from, and they come from people of import. My family is prestigious. My name stands eternal, like a sacred temple.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: The Caravago's were scavenger royalty in the wastes during the disaspora.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Caravago's were scavenger royalty in the wastes during the disaspora.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: Inheritance and knowing your roots should be a human right. But nowadays you only inherit the debt of your ancestors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Inheritance and knowing your roots should be a human right. But nowadays you only inherit the debt of your ancestors.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: So people cut themselves off from their lineage. We no longer have the support of a family history to hold us up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So people cut themselves off from their lineage. We no longer have the support of a family history to hold us up.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: I know. That's why I said it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know. That's why I said it.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: Yes, well, I can see why someone without family distinction would say that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, well, I can see why someone without family distinction would say that.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: And of course my family position comes with financial privileges. I have a significant familial estate to manage.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And of course my family position comes with financial privileges. I have a significant familial estate to manage.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: I'm comfortable. And I suppose that makes me somewhat of a tourist in this world. But I enjoy the simple pleasures I find here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm comfortable. And I suppose that makes me somewhat of a tourist in this world. But I enjoy the simple pleasures I find here.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: Are you going to fire me now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you going to fire me now?

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: That I cannot do. Estate managers have a contractual obligation to never to gift any money to debtors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That I cannot do. Estate managers have a contractual obligation to never to gift any money to debtors.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: And I can't lose that income.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I can't lose that income.

nodes.speaker: Maria Cardilini
nodes.text: Certainly. Shall I get back to work?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Certainly. Shall I get back to work?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I got a question, Maria.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I got a question, Maria.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I was thinking about your background.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was thinking about your background.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I was thinking about your background.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I was thinking about your background.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That thing with you being of nobility...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That thing with you being of nobility...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That thing with you being of nobility...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That thing with you being of nobility...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How far back do you know your ancestors?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How far back do you know your ancestors?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How far back do you know your ancestors?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How far back do you know your ancestors?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: With who?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: With who?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The Carovago?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Carovago?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So your family tree is very old?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So your family tree is very old?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So your family tree is very old?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So your family tree is very old?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We shouldn't rely on our family history to define us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We shouldn't rely on our family history to define us.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We shouldn't rely on our family history to define us.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We shouldn't rely on our family history to define us.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's kinda sad.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's kinda sad.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait, you're rich?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, you're rich?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you're just slumming it down here for fun?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you're just slumming it down here for fun?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you're just slumming it down here for fun?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you're just slumming it down here for fun?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well at least you are honest about your privilege.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well at least you are honest about your privilege.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well at least you are honest about your privilege.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well at least you are honest about your privilege.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I appreciate your honesty, but...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I appreciate your honesty, but...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. This job should go to someone who needs it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. This job should go to someone who needs it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes. This job should go to someone who needs it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes. This job should go to someone who needs it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure. But you could help someone with a lot of debt, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure. But you could help someone with a lot of debt, right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure. But you could help someone with a lot of debt, right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure. But you could help someone with a lot of debt, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, then you ARE fired.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, then you ARE fired.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Understandable. Get back to work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Understandable. Get back to work.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think you better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you better.
